sum: Prenetics Global Limited operates as a consumer health sciences company in the United States and Hong Kong. The company focuses on advancing human health and longevity through science-backed products under the IM8 brand. It also operates a consumer genetic testing brand in CircleDNA leveraging sequencing technology to deliver personalized reports across various categories. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.
ceo: Mr. Sheng Wu  Yeung (Co-Founder, Chairperson & CEO)
